items.detail: The live bot answered “1e-4”; the paper uses a 4000-step warmup then inverse-square-root decay. Gold evidence: page 7, chunk 88990.
items.title: Add the Transformer learning-rate question (q41) to the eval

items.detail: Today `evals/run_eval.py` scores whether the right page comes back (hit@5). Add answer scoring against the gold answer: exact match for facts, an LLM judge for paraphrases, reported per question type and run in CI.
items.title: Score answers, not just retrieval

items.detail: When retrieved passages don't support an answer, say so instead of guessing. Ship only if the answer eval shows fewer wrong answers without losing correct ones.
items.title: Say “not in the papers” when evidence is thin

items.detail: Verify every [n] against the passage it cites; model-written citations can be hallucinated too.
items.title: Check that each citation supports its sentence

items.detail: Chunk 88990 reads “according to the formula:” with the formula missing. Use Docling's formula output or keep the page image for equation-heavy pages, and count how many chunks have the same gap.
items.title: Recover equations lost in PDF extraction

items.detail: A few scripted conversations (“what is orca?” then “how was it trained?”) to cover history handling after the Oct 3 `chat.py` refactor.

items.detail: API Gateway usage plans or a WAF rate rule, and per-user Bedrock cost in Langfuse.
